_about: Idea bank for the Mixtape app (tlm/gui.py). Each genre's ideas are dealt 4 at a time from a shuffled deck. 'text' fills the main field (title, product or premise); reviews also carry a rating and category; 'mixup' marks a deliberate genre collision. Add your own - the app picks them up on its next launch.
